subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve visible pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared messages.ackText config, a non-terminal send-and-continue hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but each viable fix adds new config or plugin/channel API surface and changes visible message delivery across channels.

options.title: Approve shared ackText config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

options.title: Add a non-terminal hook first
options.body: Expose a typed plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and then continue normal dispatch, leaving policy to plugins or channel owners.

options.title: Keep placeholders channel-specific
options.body: Leave this as a product/API decision and implement narrower Telegram, Slack, Discord, or Feishu placeholder requests where each channel owns its UX.

recommendation.title: Approve shared ackText config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and recent cross-channel dispatch/acknowledgement work make this the best available owner for the API/product boundary decision.
